##### C.1.1.9	Results from source [20]

###### C.1.1.9.1	Description of evaluation scenarios

In this section, we present simulation results for positioning accuracies in Rel.16 under baseline assumptions. The scope of evaluation is limited to DL-TDOA and UL-TDOA. Both frequency ranges (FR1 and FR2) are considered.  The scenarios evaluated are:

-	Urban Macro (UMa)

-	Urban Micro (UMi)

-	Indoor Open Office ( IOO)

-	Indoor Factory SH

-	Indoor Factory DH
